Before You Book

Common questions

I haven't trained in years — am I too unfit for this?
Not even close. Women's Club is built for women who haven't trained in a long time. Every session is scaled by your coach on the spot, and most members started exactly where you are right now.
How many sessions a week, and how long?
You pick any 3 sessions a week, and each one runs 45 minutes — short enough to fit a busy schedule, long enough to actually move the needle.
Are the sessions women only?
Yes. Every session is women only — no mirrors, no posing, no intimidation. Just women working hard and backing each other in.
What about hormones, perimenopause or recovery after kids?
Our coaches understand training around the realities of being a woman 30+ — perimenopause, postnatal recovery, hormonal shifts and old injuries. We program around your body, not against it.
Am I locked into a long contract?
No. You should stay because you love the results and the community — not because you're trapped. We'll walk through flexible options on your call.
What's the catch with the members cap?
We deliberately cap memberships so coaching quality stays high and you're never just a number. Most members renew month after month, so spots only open up now and then — which is why we're inviting a few locals in this month.
